sources.snippet: Starcoder2-3b Welcome to StarCoder 2.3b, a powerful language model designed for fine-tuning and generating text based on prompts. This README file will guide you through the setup process and provide basic instructions for using the model and associated scripts.

sources.title: StarCoder2 3B - fireworks.ai
sources.snippet: StarCoder2-3B is a 3B parameter model trained on 17 programming languages from The Stack v2, with opt-out requests excluded. The model uses Grouped Query Attention, a context window of 16,384 tokens with a sliding window attention of 4,096 tokens, and was trained using the Fill-in-the-Middle objective on 3+ trillion tokens.
